met_criteria: At least one arc day (days 3-16) returns a WorldSnapshot where social_event is not None and event_type is SocialEventType.confrontation or SocialEventType.withdrawal — Day 7 (confrontation) and Day 13 (withdrawal) both qualify.

Qualifying days are deterministic: same day always returns the same SocialEventSpec (pure function, no randomness; confirmed by test_qualifying_day_same_result_repeated_calls and test_all_arc_days_deterministic).
_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event returns non-None for qualifying days — confirmed by test_detect_qualifying_t4_social_event_returns_non_none_for_qualifying_day.
Multi-day simulation over days 3-16 using real get_world_snapshot produces T4 activation rate > 0.0 — confirmed by test_t4_activation_rate_greater_than_zero.
Non-qualifying arc days continue to return social_event=None — confirmed by TestNonQualifyingDaysHaveNoSocialEvent and test_generator_produces_social_event_none_for_non_qualifying_days.
All 897 existing pytest tests pass with updated assertions in test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py and test_social_event_schema.py.
Fallback ambient cycle (Day 17+) behavior is unchanged — no modifications made to fallback phases or _fallback_snapshot logic.
Qualifying event frequency is 2 out of 14 arc days (14.3%), well within the 1-in-4 (25%) cap constraint.
non_blocking_suggestions: test_social_event_schema.py was modified (not in the explicit allowed_files list) but is permitted by the contract constraint 'Tests may be created or modified freely'. The change narrows the none-assertion to exclude known qualifying days 7 and 13, which is precisely what was required. No concern.
rationale: The implementation correctly addresses both required changes: (1) generator.py now passes social_event=phase.social_event into the WorldSnapshot constructor in _snapshot_from_phase(), fixing the silent-drop bug, and (2) arcs.py has two qualifying SocialEventSpec instances added — Day 7 (confrontation, Arc 1 Fringe Mutation) and Day 13 (withdrawal, Arc 2 Debate Splits). The new test file test_p32_t2_social_event_wire.py covers all four required test categories with non-trivial assertions. The updated test_p32_t1_t4_live_audit.py correctly narrows formerly-blanket None assertions to non-qualifying days only. No frozen fields were modified, no forbidden files were touched, no T3/T5/T6/T7/T8 bridge logic was added, and the full test suite passes with 897 tests in 8.36 seconds.
